message: Vector Rebel 3.2.55 allows selecting only the SCBA locations checked on a given day.
releaseNotes: Station 4 SCBA Airpacks now offers three independent location checkboxes for Truck 504, Medic 504, and Station 4 SCBA Supply Room, with none selected at the start of a new check. The inspector may choose any non-empty subset. Native Equipment > Standard location filters must match that subset; Set Vector Filters opens the native control and briefly preserves the pending selection for return to the same check. The read-only scanner only includes selected locations and fails closed on missing or extra native location filters. Existing draft-only and no-automatic-life-safety-inspection boundaries remain.
